hero.title: We build what lasts.
hero.subtitle: Full-scope contracting, interior design, and project delivery — engineered with precision, finished with intent.

about.title: A team built around the drawing board.
about.body: We're a multidisciplinary team of engineers, designers, and site managers who treat every project as a system — not a checklist. From first sketch to final handover, we hold the same standard: built right, on time, without surprises.
about.point_1_body: Every project starts on paper before it starts on site.
about.point_2_body: Design, fit-out, and mechanical teams under one roof.
about.point_3_body: You see the schedule and the budget, always.

services.title: Services, end to end.
services.s1_body: Civil, structural, and finishing works for commercial and residential builds.
services.s2_body: Spaces designed around how people actually use them.
services.s3_body: Mechanical, electrical, and thermal systems built to spec and code.
services.s4_body: Temporary and permanent structures for brands that need to show up.
services.s5_body: Sourcing and logistics for materials, fixtures, and equipment.
services.s6_body: Maintenance and rapid response after the keys change hands.
